description: Fetches weapon specifications (caliber, weight, rate of fire, etc.) from gunrf.ru English pages.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_weapon_specs: Fetch detailed specifications for a weapon from its URL; 参数: url; 必填: 无
  - search_weapons: Discover weapon pages by crawling category links; 参数: category; 必填: 无

url.description: Weapon page URL on gunrf.ru (required for get_weapon_specs). Must be an English page ending in _eng.html.

category.description: Weapon category to search (used by search_weapons). Default is 'avtomat' for assault rifles.
